versions.content: Handling if EthSwt_MacSecUpdateTxSa is called with Active is set to TRUE , the secured association is deactivated and EthSwtPort- MacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If EthSwt_MacSecUpdateTxSa is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthSwtPortMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthSwtPort identified with the given SwitchPortIdx at the EthSwtConfig identified with the given SwitchIdx • the given API parameter Active is set to TRUE • the transmission secured association given with An exists and is deactivated then the EthSwt driver shall perform the following actions • update the transmission secure association at the Ethernet switch port that cor- responds to the given SwitchPortIdx at the Ethernet switch that corresponds to the given SwitchIdx by considering the next packet number (see NextPn ) • activate the transmission secure association given with An at this Ethernet switch port • if another transmission secured association at this Ethernet switch port is running, then disable this secured association • return with E_OK Otherwise, if the addressed transmission secured association given with An does not exist, return with E_NOT_OK
